translationRepairs: As grand minister of agriculture he let contractors use his clients as labor; the accounts fell deep into arrears.
As grand minister of agriculture, he entrusted men with the work and his retainers engaged in hire-contracts; much of the revenue fell into arrears.

任人賓客僦 means he entrusted/appointed people and his guests engaged in hire-leasing, not that contractors used his clients as labor; the proposal corrects the agency but is awkward, so the idiomatic is restated more naturally while keeping 入多逋負 as revenue arrears.
Gaozu ordered all former ministers of Xiang Yu to name Yu [by his personal name as contempt]; Lord Zheng alone did not comply with the edict.
Gaozu ordered all former ministers of Xiang Yu to call Yu by his personal name; Lord Zheng alone did not comply with the edict.
名籍 is simply to call Xiang Yu by his personal name 籍; the bracketed gloss “as contempt” is not in the Chinese and does not belong in the literal field.
